props.name: label
props.description: The label for the combobox.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text for assistive technology and form help.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message text for assistive technology and validation feedback.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the current value is invalid.

props.name: prefix
props.description: An icon or text rendered before the input.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | Node | JSX.ArrayElement | (string & {}) | ((item: T) => JSX.Element)

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }

props.name: id
props.description: An ID for the combobox.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler called when focus moves away from the combobox input.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler called when focus moves to the combobox input.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler called when selection changes (single mode).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ID of an element that describes the combobox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: An accessible label for the combobox when no visible label is provided.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The ID of an element that labels the combobox.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the combobox is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the combobox should be auto-focused.

props.name: form
props.description: The form owner for the combobox input.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the combobox, used when submitting an HTML form.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler called when the focus state changes.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode for the combobox.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The currently selected keys (controlled, multiple mode).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The default selected keys (uncontrolled, multiple mode).

props.name: items
props.description: The items to render in the combobox.

props.name: shouldFocusWrap
props.description: Whether focus should wrap from the last item to the first.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Function to get the key from an item.

props.name: getTextValue
props.description: Function to get the text value from an item.

props.name: getDisabled
props.description: Function to check if an item is disabled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of disabled items.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the combobox is open by default (uncontrolled).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the combobox is open (controlled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler called when the open state changes.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the combobox is read-only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the combobox is required.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the input when no value is entered.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Describes the type of autocomplete functionality the input should provide.

props.name: defaultItems
props.description: The default items to render in the combobox when uncontrolled.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The currently selected key (controlled, single mode).

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The default selected key (uncontrolled, single mode).

props.name: onSelectionChangeMultiple
props.description: Handler called when selection changes (multiple mode).

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The current input value (controlled).

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: The default input value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Handler called when input value changes.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The filter function to use for filtering items.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Whether to allow custom values that don't match any item.

props.name: allowsEmptyCollection
props.description: Whether to allow an empty collection (show listbox even with no matches).

props.name: menuTrigger
props.description: The trigger mechanism for the combobox menu.

props.name: formValue
props.description: Controls what value is submitted in forms. - 'key': submit the selected key via hidden input (default) - 'text': submit the text input value When allowsCustomValue is true, formValue is forced to 'text'.
